findings.answer: Compared with Folk songs from the same month (other features held fixed), the biggest differences are Acapella x1.38 (CI x0.71-x2.70, n=51); Rock x1.34 (CI x1.22-x1.47, n=1278); Electro x1.26 (CI x1.12-x1.42, n=1023); Folk Rock x1.21 (CI x1.01-x1.45, n=52). Together the genre terms explain 0.59% of the variation in views within a month.
findings.verdict_reason: q < 0.0001: very unlikely to be chance, even after correcting for every test run.
